contexts.text: They took stones, and made a heap () = truths from good... The reason a heap = good, is from this... before they built altars they made heaps, and ate upon them for a witness that they were conjoined in love. But afterwards, when the representatives of the Ancients were accounted holy, instead of heaps they built altars also of stones, but disposed in a more orderly manner (). Hence the like is signified by a heap as by an altar; namely, the good of love; and by the stones therein, the truths of faith. AC 4197:5.
And they did eat there upon the heap () = appropriation from good Divine... A heap = good; here, good Divine.

Jegar-sahadutha (), in the idiom of Syria, means the heap of witness... Anciently, such heaps were for a sign, or for a witness, and afterwards also for worship; here, for a sign and for a witness; for a sign, that the boundary was there; and for a witness, that a covenant was there made, and that none of them should pass it to do evil to the other... But in the internal sense, it = the quality of good from truths on the part of Laban; that is, on the part of those who are in the goods of works; that is, on the part of the gentiles.
Jacob called it Galeed () = the quality on the part of the good of the Divine Natural... Galeed means a heap and a witness, or a witness heap, in the Hebrew idiom.
And Laban said, This heap is a witness between me and between thee this day () = that it shall be so to eternity... A heap = good. Explained.

Behold this heap () = conjunction... For the heap and the statue were for a sign and for a witness that a covenant had been made; that is, that there was friendship; thus, in the internal sense, that there was conjunction.
This heap is a witness () = confirmation. A witness = confirmation; namely... of truth from good, which is the heap.

If I will not pass this heap to thee, and if thou wilt not pass this heap and this statue to me, for evil () = a limit of the amount of what can inflow from good... A heap = good; and a statue, truth; and both the heap and the statue were for a sign and for a witness... As truths are what good inflows into, it is truths which limit the influx of good. Explained.
A heap of the carcase, neither is there an end of the body () = that thence were innumerable evils, and those who are in evils.

They gathered them into heaps, into heaps () = that these reasoning falsities were disposed fascicularly in the Natural... The reason to be gathered into heaps has this signification, is that all things which are in man's mind are disposed into series, and as it were into bundles; and into series within series, or into bundles within bundles...
The reason it also = for memory, is that in ancient times they built heaps for a witness and a memory of a thing which was to stand firm and which they would remember; and afterwards, altars also.

And a heap is consumed () = injury to the truths and goods of faith which have been received. A heap = the truth and good of faith which has been received. The reason a heap has this signification, is that it is a crop already gathered in; and by a standing crop is signified the truth and good of faith in their conception.
As the scattered heaps... from which a house is to be formed.
The vastation of the Church as to doctrine is meant by, Thou hast made of a city a heap... ().
Asshur hath founded it for heaps () = that reasoning from falsities has destroyed.
A heap of the field () = the devastation of the Church.

The falsification of truth and the adulteration of good, from which are mere falsities and evils, are signified by to give Jerusalem for heaps, and by to reduce the cities of Judah into a waste... (). AE 1100:14.
